result.title: Enforcing Symmetries on Pre-trained ML Models for Physics
result.summary: Post-hoc group averaging (or test-time augmentation) is a simple way to impose symmetry on a trained predictor without changing its architecture or retraining it. For finite and compact groups, averaging over a normalized Haar measure on the group gives the Reynolds operator: a canonical projection onto invariant or equivariant predictors with known non-increasing risk guarantees under certain assumptions. This paper provides numerical experiments on physics emulation models that demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach in this setting. We then extend this framework to non-compact group symmetries. For non-compact groups, the Haar measure cannot be normalized, so group averaging cannot be defined in the same way. We replace it with three alternatives: the Weyl unitary trick (which requires complexifying the space and extending the predictor), a data-dependent orthogonal projection (which involves a non-trivial optimization on the space of invariant or equivariant functions), and a frame averaging approach (which involves mapping each point to a set of orbit representatives). We illustrate the constructions theoretically and empirically on the unit-rescaling group and the Lorentz group. Our results show that in the non-compact case, the Weyl trick and frame averaging do not provide a consistent improvement over the baseline, except where the test data is out-of-distribution (an orders-of-magnitude improvement in this case) and, for the Weyl trick, in low-data regimes. The orthogonal projection can provide improvements in-distribution and out-of-distribution. We also observe that models trained directly on invariant features matched or beat the projection of an unconstrained one. We conclude that post-hoc symmetrization extends to non-compact groups, but it does not consistently outperform training a symmetric model.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究在已训练好的物理仿真模型上事后施加群对称性：对有限与紧群用群平均（Reynolds 算子）投影到不变/等变预测器，对非紧群改用 Weyl 技巧、数据依赖正交投影和 frame averaging 三种替代，并在单位缩放群与洛伦兹群上做理论与数值验证，结论是后验对称化可延伸到非紧群，但不稳定优于直接训练对称模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 把预测器投影到不变/等变子空间以及用轨道代表集合做聚合，可能与 LVR 中 latent 表示的对称性、几何结构和多假设聚合有概念联系，可供核查；但论文无视觉推理或 latent 证据使用实验，属较远领域的思路借鉴。
